These transcripts are copied byte for byte from long-term-memory-structure's own tests (tag `v0.2.0`, `test/fixtures/`),
MIT licensed. They are synthetic: hand-written or generated, with invented text. The view layer's tests read them to
check that it shows the turns, calls and compactions `ltms` prints for each one. They came here from ltms-gui (commit
287280b), with those tests.
